description: Known-bad bundles the adapter must reject, and one it must accept. Registered so `adversarial: true` in the manifest is a test rather than a self-report: a backend nothing has ever failed is unaudited, not trustworthy.

reject.why: cells as replicates for a population claim
finds a difference between two halves of the control
analysed context drifted from the frozen one
a retracted source in the ledger
causal and clinical language on a transcriptomic readout
confounders marked addressed with no recorded result
preregistration hash does not match its file
asserts confounders clear that its own pinned diagnostics call dominant
reaches for independent replication with a ledger of preprints and reviews

accept.why: donor-crossed design, recomputed effect, negative control silent

reject_replication.why: same accession and same preregistration — not an independent source
